evidence: A model of the vacuum buildout's economy built on stated paths of technology (period_technology.json) and stated inputs (period_inputs.json), each with its basis; the settlements' quantities are their design studies'. The paths beyond their sourced values, the rates of work, the plant masses, the bounds on visits and depot sales, the set-aside shares of the sources' water and the open design choices are the study's own. Results hold on those inputs and show what they imply; no plant, market, price, site or source is qualified. The time to exhaustion is a rough projection with technology held at its 2241 values.
units: Years of the programme (zero is 2041); residents; kilograms and tonnes as named; watts and gigawatts; constant dollars of 2041.
reading_rule: Each case is one scenario of demand, one technology case and one schedule of residents to 2341 (year 300). Money is the account with Earth: receipts from Earth's customers against what the settlement pays Earth. Funding needed is the deepest the cumulative account goes; the opening funding is how deep it goes by year 8; the net present values discount each year's net to year zero at the rate named, to years 100, 200 and 300; repaid_year is the first year after the opening in which the cumulative account is not negative and payback_year the first from which it stays so to 2341. A solved schedule gives its growth rates. at_year holds chosen years in full and every_fifth_year a series of years 0, 5, ..., 300. A case's years after its water runs out (exhausted_year) are not physical. Each exhaustion projection carries one path on to 3541 at most and names the years the plan is reached, the sites are full and the water open to mining runs out.
